route_title: Optimization of 6-Layer All-Dielectric Polarizing Beam Splitter
compilation_rationale: The request specifies a fixed 6-layer stack with explicit materials (TiO2, SiO2) and bounds. TE/TM mapping is applied to s/p polarizations. The composite objective is decomposed into separate mean objectives for TE reflectance and TM transmittance. Robustness parameters are mapped to the uncertainty block. Total thickness minimization is included as an optimization target.
